_about: Finance test questions. 'context' is the gold reading of the question (dates, named document), so search can be tested apart from how well the LLM reads dates. 'accept' = the document versions a correct answer may come from. 'expect' / 'forbid' = text the answer must / must not contain (numbers are compared without thousands separators). 'version' = the policy version the question is about; 'faq_gold' says, per version, which FAQ entries are outdated (written by hand from the policy text, not computed by the code under test). Synthetic cases were checked against the synthetic policy (scripts/make_synthetic_policy.py). Real-document cases are added only after a person has checked the answer in the document itself, ideally confirmed by the finance office.

faq_gold._how: An FAQ entry is outdated under a version when the rule it answers reads differently there than in the version it was decided under. Checked by hand against data/finance/synthetic/*.md. FAQ-003 (CC-601) never changes.
